description_en: Queries a list of ApsaraDB RDS instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS的实例列表
name: DescribeDBInstances

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 废弃参数，无需配置
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB

By default, instances of all database engine types are returned
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型。取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB

默认返回所有数据库类型
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance status. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例状态，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html
parameters.name: db_instance_status

parameters.help_en: The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例的过期状态。取值：
True：已过期
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used for fuzzy search by instance ID or instance description
parameters.help_zh: 可基于实例ID或者实例备注模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型。取值：
Primary：主实例
Readonly：只读实例
Guard：灾备实例
Temp：临时实例

默认返回所有实例类型
parameters.name: db_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：1~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The network type of the instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络类型。取值：
VPC：专有网络下的实例
Classic：经典网络下的实例

默认返回所有网络类型下的实例
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The database engine version
parameters.help_zh: 数据库版本
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The billing method. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：包年包月
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The access mode of the instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例的访问模式。取值：
Standard：标准访问模式
Safe：数据库代理模式

默认返回所有访问模式下的实例
parameters.name: connection_mode

parameters.help_en: The tags that are bound to the instance. Each tag consists of a TagKey and a TagValue. You can specify up to 5 tags in a single request. Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}. If the instance matches any of the specified tags, the instance information is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询绑定有该标签的实例，包括TagKey和TagValue。单次最多支持传入5组值，格式：{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}。命中任意传入的一组Tag就会返回该实例信息
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The host ID in the dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群内的主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the instance edition (Category) information. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回实例系列（Category）信息。取值：
0：不返回
1：返回
parameters.name: instance_level

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: query_auto_renewal

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the instance. You can use this endpoint to query the corresponding instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的连接地址。通过该连接地址查询对应的实例
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call to the DescribeDBInstances operation. If the results span multiple pages, you can use this token to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 翻页凭证。取值为上一次调用DescribeDBInstances接口时返回的NextToken参数值。如果调用结果分多页展示，再次调用接口时传入该值便可以展示下一页的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 30.
If you specify this parameter, the PageSize and PageNumber parameters are not available
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值：1~100。

默认值：30。
传入该参数，则PageSize和PageNumber参数不可用
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The JSON string that contains the instance filter conditions and their values
parameters.help_zh: 实例过滤条件参数及其值的JSON串
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The edition of the instance. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例的系列。取值：
Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
cluster：集群系列
serverless_basic：Serverless
parameters.name: category
